## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm exec nx affected -t lint typecheck test build` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or real personal data in code, fixtures or logs
- [ ] Docs and the epic work log updated when behaviour or commands changed
- [ ] If a snapshot changed: **Why did this snapshot change?** (explain below, and say it was reviewed by hand, not just updated with `-u`)
- [ ] New or changed UI component (`.tsx` in `apps/*/src` or `packages/ui/src`): its `*.stories.tsx` is added or updated, so its DOM snapshot covers it
